body:
The issue is the subtraction result. When we compute `INT_MAX - INT_MIN`, the mathematical result would be: `2147483647 - (-2147483648) = 4294967295`, which exceeds the range of a 32-bit signed integer, causing the integer overflow.

There are a few ways I can see this fixed:
1. Rearranging the comparison algebraically to avoid the subtraction altogether (less code entropy)
2. Cast the limits to a wider type (like int64_t) before doing the subtraction (type diff, so not ideal)
3. Use floating point arithmetic since the `screen_rect.size` is already the real_t type (cleanest imo)

I've submitted a PR for the first fix as that will cause the least entropy to the code: #111651
